Pakistani boxer inspired by Mary Kom, wins historic medal

Fatima Zahra of Pakistan became the country's first female boxer to win a medal at the Commonwealth Games. She has credited Indian boxer Mary Kom as an inspiration for her achievement. Zahra expressed her ambition to emulate Kom's success, stating, 'Inshallah, I will become like her.' This historic win marks a significant moment for women's boxing in Pakistan.
